verse.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
verse.simplify: The fruit of the Spirit is the character God grows in a person over time: love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness and self-control.

verse.text: Make yourself an ark of gopherwood; make rooms in the ark, and cover it inside and outside with pitch.
verse.simplify: God tells Noah to build a large boat out of gopher wood, with rooms inside, and to seal it inside and out. It shows that God's rescue plan required real, practical work from Noah.

verse.text: Make yourself an ark of gopherwood; make rooms in the ark, and cover it inside and outside with pitch. And this is how you shall make it: The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits. You shall make a window for the ark, and you shall finish it to a cubit from above; and set the door of the ark in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third decks. And behold, I Myself am bringing floodwaters on the earth, to destroy from under heaven all flesh in which is the breath of life; everything that is on the earth shall die.
verse.simplify: God tells Noah to build a large boat out of gopher wood, with rooms inside, and to seal it inside and out. It shows that God's rescue plan required real, practical work from Noah.

verse.text: And now abide faith, hope, love, these three; but the greatest of these is love.
verse.simplify: Faith, hope, and love remain, and love is the greatest of the three. Of everything you can pursue, love is the most important.

verse.text: For assuredly, I say to you, whoever says to this mountain, "Be removed and be cast into the sea,' and does not doubt in his heart, but believes that those things he says will be done, he will have whatever he says.
verse.simplify: Jesus said that anyone who tells a mountain to throw itself into the sea, without doubting in their heart but believing what they say will happen, will get what they ask for. He was teaching that real faith in God is powerful.

verse.text: Therefore you now have sorrow; but I will see you again and your heart will rejoice, and your joy no one will take from you.
verse.simplify: They were sad then, but Jesus would see them again and their joy would be permanent. It means the joy Jesus gives cannot be taken away by anyone.

verse.text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort, who comforts us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any trouble, with the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
verse.simplify: Paul praises God, calling him the Father of mercies and the God of all comfort. This tells the reader that God is the source of every kindness and every bit of comfort they will ever need. God comforts us in all our troubles so that we can pass that same comfort on to others who are struggling. Your own hard times can become the very thing that lets you help someone else.

verse.text: As one whom his mother comforts, So I will comfort you; And you shall be comforted in Jerusalem."
verse.simplify: Just as a mother comforts her child, God will comfort his people, and that comfort will be found in Jerusalem. It means God's comfort is personal and tender, like a mother's, not cold or distant.

verse.text: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; For You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
verse.simplify: The Lord leads, provides and protects all the way through. Even in the darkest valley, you are not walking alone.

verse.text: But even if you should suffer for righteousness' sake, you are blessed. "And do not be afraid of their threats, nor be troubled."
verse.simplify: Even if you suffer for doing right, you are blessed; don't be afraid of what frightens others or let it shake you. Suffering for good doesn't mean God has abandoned you.
